Name: Ahikam, Son of Shaphan
Summary: Ahikam, son of Shaphan, was one of Josiah's messengers to Huldah, and later protected Jeremiah; he was the father of Gedaliah, governor after the fall.
KeyStory: Ahikam sent to Huldah and father of Gedaliah.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Shaphan, Scribe; Huldah, Prophetess; Gedaliah, Son of Ahikam; Shaphan, Son of Azaliah; Huldah, the Prophetess
LifeLesson: A faithful official's son governed the remnant his father's king had lost.
